description:
This 2018 Toyota RAV4 XLE delivers reliable everyday SUV performance with a well-rounded package of comfort and safety features. The AWD drivetrain provides confident traction and smooth power delivery, while the 2.5-litre four-cylinder engine offers practical efficiency for daily commuting and family trips. With 101,906 km on the odometer, this RAV4 represents solid mid-life value for buyers seeking a dependable compact SUV.

The XLE trim stands out with genuine comfort upgrades that make regular driving more enjoyable. Heated seats and a heated steering wheel add warmth on cooler days, while dual-zone automatic climate control lets front passengers set their preferred temperatures independently. Power seats adjust easily to find your ideal driving position, and the panoramic moonroof brings natural light and airiness to the cabin. Driver assistance features including adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring, and lane departure warning provide helpful support on highways and city streets, while the back-up camera makes parking and reversing straightforward. Bluetooth connectivity and steering wheel audio controls keep your music and calls accessible without taking your hands off the wheel.
Key Features
  • Trim & Packages: XLE trim with comprehensive comfort and convenience equipment
  • Performance & Capability: AWD drivetrain for confident traction; 173 hp 2.5L automatic engine
  • Comfort & Convenience: Heated seats, heated steering wheel, dual-zone climate control, power seats, panoramic moonroof
  • Safety & Driver Assistance: Adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, lane departure warning, back-up camera
  • Entertainment & Media: Bluetooth connection, steering wheel audio controls
Contact us at Genesis Ottawa to arrange a test drive or learn more about this well-equipped RAV4 XLE.
